title: Can Claude replace Zylo? 31/31 checks, 6 spec gaps #shorts
description:
Claude built a Zylo alternative, a SaaS spend tracker with owners, yearly costs and notice-deadline reminders, from one written spec: all 31 acceptance checks passed, and the build exposed 6 gaps in the spec.

Full build test (2:45): https://youtu.be/m8hlTu5_bkY
The free spec: https://personalsoftwarefactory.com/blueprints/saas-spend-tracker
Zylo pricing and alternatives: https://personalsoftwarefactory.com/alternatives/zylo

Zylo does not publish prices: Core, Premium and Enterprise are sold by quote (zylo.com/pricing, October 2026).

Made with AI: Sam's on-camera hook and outro are an AI avatar of him, and the narration is his AI voice clone (HeyGen). The product footage is from the real test build.

Music: "Chill Wave" by Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com). Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 License, http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/
